title: Pregnant Blend 2-Mix Trio #23 (가로 띠 3구역·매끈 / 동심원 3구역·매끈 / 대각 띠 3구역·물결)

The bands of every pattern curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare.
